violations.text: Raw animal foods (such as raw eggs) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (such as guacamole) in the 2 door refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. PIC relocated raw eggs. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/24/2026

Egg bagels and home fries were observed held between 99-128 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC reheated. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/24/2026

Inspector observed inconstant datemarking. Some items were dated with the date of preparation (meat kitchen), while other items were marked with date of use (dairy kitchen). Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 09/24/2026
Inspector observed tomato sauce, which was previously cooked, with a date of preparation exceeding the 7 day date marking. PIC discarded. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/24/2026

The concentration of the sanitizer solution for the wet wiping cloths was less than 100 parts per million (ppm). The required concentration for quat sanitizer is 200-400 ppm. PIC refilled and retested. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/24/2026

The facility is lacking thermo labels or similar internal temperature indicating device for the dish machine at the dishwashers in both kitchens. Current dishwasher thermometers were not working during inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 09/24/2026
The sink used for food preparation AND steam units are lacking an air gap. Current setup is an air break. New Violation. Correct By: 10/08/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (steam kettle lid) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. PIC took unit out of service to be washed/sanitized. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/30/2025

Thermometers are lacking in the dairy kosher kitchen refrigeration units. Cold holding equipment used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods must have at least one thermometer that is located to allow easy viewing of the temperature display. PIC placed thermometers in units during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/30/2025

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. New Violation. Correct By: 11/09/2024
The establishment does not have a written procedure for cleaning vomit and diarrhea. English Responding to Vomiting and Diarrhea Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/30/2024

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (can opener in dairy kitchen) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/30/2024
There is insufficient refrigeration equipment/capacity for proper cooling for catering. New Violation. Correct By: 11/09/2024
